snippet.title: Hunters In The Dark - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hunters In The Dark is a new Pacman-style frantic party game for 1–6 players. It will be released on Steam on June 19th, 2026. 

Public demo is available now! 

Steam Page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753790/Hunters_In_The_Dark/ 

Wishlist and subscribe! 

For feedback and community: 
Utopia Machina Discord: https://discord.gg/7acDCmeMjk 
Wild Ox Studios Discord: https://discord.gg/wRAUvuZGd9
